sub_locations.name: The Ship's Wheel
sub_locations.description: The Ship's Wheel had a reputation for being one of the safest taverns around. Most activity within the tavern never got more exciting than the old patrons watching each others hair fall out.

sub_locations.name: The Wandering Wemic
sub_locations.description: Rooms could be had at the Wandering Wemic at a rate of 10 gp per night and included stabling, a valet service used for cleaning or repairing gear, and one bottle of wine per person per evening.

sub_locations.name: Fiery Flagon
sub_locations.description: The Fiery Flagon was a stately old tavern that served excellent food.

sub_locations.name: The Sleeping Snake
sub_locations.description: Rowdy tavern for dockhands and dancers, owner by [[Alard Belaerl]].

sub_locations.name: Shipmasters' Hall
sub_locations.description: Shipmasters' Hall was an inn.

sub_locations.name: Selûne's Smile
sub_locations.description: Selûne's Smile, also known as the Inn of the Crescent Moon, was a tavern and inn devoted to [[Selûne]]. Uniquely, it was established and run by an [[avatar]] of the goddess Selûne.

sub_locations.name: The Red Gauntlet
sub_locations.description: Food served here consisted mostly of dried fish, waybread, and rabbit-and-fowl stew. Drink consisted of a house wine. The fares were cheap in the Red Gauntlet with a plate of food running just 3 cp and a tankard 2 cp.

sub_locations.name: Copper Cup
sub_locations.description: The Copper Cup was a [[festhall]].

sub_locations.name: Yawning Portal
sub_locations.description: The Yawning Portal inn gained most of its renown for being the primary open route to the [[Undermountain]].

sub_locations.name: Bowels of the Earth
sub_locations.description: The tavern was a well-known spot for hiring [[mercenaries]].

sub_locations.name: Rearing Hippocampus
sub_locations.description: The Rearing Hippocampus was an inn.

sub_locations.name: The Blackstar Inn
sub_locations.description: The Blackstar Inn was owned by [[Asiyra Boldwinter]] during the mid-to-late 14th century DR. Armed guards protected the entryway and the stables.

sub_locations.name: Swords' Rest
sub_locations.description: Swords' Rest was a tavern and a good place to hire [[mercenaries]].

sub_locations.name: Felzoun's Folly
sub_locations.description: This tavern was frequently quite crowded and noisy, but overall was a casual place where merchants and consumers alike stopped for a quick bite or drink.

sub_locations.name: Ship's Prow
sub_locations.description: The inn's name derived from the fact that it was converted into a building from the prow of a ship.

sub_locations.name: The Mermaid's Arms
sub_locations.description: The Mermaid's Arms was a pricey and busy tavern, inn, and festhall.

sub_locations.name: Blue Mermaid
sub_locations.description: The tavern was well appointed and clean, if a bit tired.

sub_locations.name: Hanging Lantern
sub_locations.description: The Hanging Lantern was a [[festhall]]. The building stood an impressive six storys tall.

sub_locations.name: Sleeping Wench
sub_locations.description: This tavern could be rather rowdy, but less so compared to the [[Sleeping Snake]] and had a comparably better clientele.

sub_locations.name: Thirsty Sailor
sub_locations.description: The Thirsty Sailor was an infamous dive bar.

sub_locations.name: Warm Beds
sub_locations.description: Warm Beds was an [[inn]].

sub_locations.name: Bloody Fist
sub_locations.description: The Bloody Fist was a [[tavern]].

sub_locations.name: Three Pearls Nightclub
sub_locations.description: The Three Pearls Nightclub was a [[festhall]] and nightclub.

sub_locations.name: Purple Palace
sub_locations.description: The Purple Palace was a [[festhall]].

sub_locations.name: Thirsty Throat
sub_locations.description: The Thirsty Throat was a [[tavern]].

sub_locations.name: Jade Dancer
sub_locations.description: The Jade Dancer was a [[festhall]] and [[tavern]].

sub_locations.name: The Full Cup
sub_locations.description: The Full Cup's patrons were mostly caravan drovers. Brawls were a common occurrence in this seedy [[tavern]].

sub_locations.name: Pampered Traveler
sub_locations.description: Pampered Traveler was a fine establishment with large, well-furnished rooms, a play area for children, and a library that guests could peruse.

sub_locations.name: Inn of the Dripping Dagger
sub_locations.description: The Inn of the Dripping Dagger was the favored bar and home to many adventurers, mercenaries, misfits and soldiers.

sub_locations.name: Mother Tathlorn's House of Pleasure and Healing
sub_locations.description: Mother Tathlorn's House of Pleasure and Healing was a festhall and spa.

sub_locations.name: Elfstone Tavern
sub_locations.description: The Elfstone Tavern was a tavern. It catered to elves and half-elves in the city.

sub_locations.name: Golden Horn Gambling House
sub_locations.description: The Golden Horn Gambling House, which was also simply called the Golden Horn, was a [[festhall]].

sub_locations.name: Unicorn's Horn
sub_locations.description: The Unicorn's Horn was an [[inn]].

sub_locations.name: Gondalim's
sub_locations.description: Gondalim's was an [[inn]].

sub_locations.name: Gentle Rest
sub_locations.description: The Gentle Rest was an [[inn]].

sub_locations.name: A Maiden's Tears
sub_locations.description: A Maiden's Tears, which was also simply called the Tears, was a tavern. The tavern was quiet compared to others located in this part of the North Ward and patrons appreciated its private booths.

sub_locations.name: The Misty Beard
sub_locations.description: Part of what made the Misty Beard famous up and down the [[Sword Coast]] was the staff which was composed of exotic or monstrous creatures from all over [[Faerûn]].

sub_locations.name: Galloping Minotaur
sub_locations.description: Galloping Minotaur was an [[inn]] that was widely known and frequented by merchants and travelers.

sub_locations.name: The Sailors' Own
sub_locations.description: The Sailors' Own was a rather shabby tavern near the docks.

sub_locations.name: Crawling Spider
sub_locations.description: The Crawling Spider was a [[tavern]]. The tavern had a mock underground decor made from plaster and rock rubble. Stuffed spiders hung from the ceiling, giving the tavern its namesake.

sub_locations.name: Sated Satyr
sub_locations.description: The Sated Satyr was a two-story, irregularly shaped building that fronted the streets or the alley on all sides but one.

sub_locations.name: Wyvern's Rest
sub_locations.description: The Wyvern's Rest was an inn. Originally constructed as a stone watch house, the Wyvern's Rest was a favorite of guards and watchmen.

sub_locations.name: Golden Harp Inn
sub_locations.description: The Golden Harp Inn was an [[inn]].

sub_locations.name: High Flagon
sub_locations.description: The High Flagon was a gambling hall and inn.

sub_locations.name: Twilight Hunters
sub_locations.description: Twilight Hunters was a tavern.

sub_locations.name: Sapphire House
sub_locations.description: Sapphire House was an expensive rooming house.

sub_locations.name: Tavern of the Flagon Dragon
sub_locations.description: The Tavern of the Flagon Dragon was a tavern.

sub_locations.name: Jhrual's Dance
sub_locations.description: Jhrual's Dance was a [[festhall]].

sub_locations.name: Smiling Siren
sub_locations.description: The Smiling Siren was a bawdy tavern/nightclub and theater that later became a [[festhall]] run by the church of [[Sune]].

sub_locations.name: Mighty Manticore
sub_locations.description: This tavern was known for its thick and flavorful stew, sharp [[cheese]], fresh black bread, and hearty ale.

sub_locations.name: The Asp's Strike
sub_locations.description: The Asp's Strike was a [[tavern]].

sub_locations.name: Grinning Lion
sub_locations.description: The Grinning Lion was a [[tavern]].

sub_locations.name: Greenglade Tower
sub_locations.description: Greenglade Tower was a popular and rather clean rooming house.

sub_locations.name: Maelstrom's Notch
sub_locations.description: The Maelstrom's Notch was an [[inn]].

sub_locations.name: Pickled Fisherman
sub_locations.description: The Pickled Fisherman was a tavern.

sub_locations.name: Soaring Pegasus
sub_locations.description: The Soaring Pegasus was a tavern.

sub_locations.name: Angry Coxswain
sub_locations.description: A [[magical]] ''[[Angry Coxswain Portal|portal]]'' existed within the tavern that Ramas and Orth used to ferry slaves to [[Mulhorand]]. The portal connected directly to a prison cell located in a market in [[Skuld]].

sub_locations.name: Singed Bolt
sub_locations.description: The Singed Bolt was a tavern.

sub_locations.name: Blushing Nymph
sub_locations.description: The Blushing Nymph, or just the Nymph, was a festhall.

sub_locations.name: Underdark
sub_locations.description: The Underdark tavern had a secret passage that led to [[Undermountain]] in the back of the establishment's basement.

sub_locations.name: The Splintered Stair
sub_locations.description: A large spiraling staircase overlooked by balconies dominated the entry of the inn. The stairway was badly damaged during an epic brawl between adventurers, giving the inn its name. The rooms for rent were large, but also dark and cold.

sub_locations.name: Madame Garah's Boarding House
sub_locations.description: Madame Garah's Boarding House was a row house used as a boarding house.

sub_locations.name: Soaring Delights
sub_locations.description: Soaring Delights was a [[:category:restaurants|restaurant]] built on the first floor of the hollow [[Hawk Man]].

sub_locations.name: Skewered Dragon
sub_locations.description: The Skewered Dragon was a tavern. The clientele was primarily made up of dock workers that were suspicious of strangers.
